newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Soymeal in Europe follows soaring Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Soymeal in Europe follows soaring Chicago.

text.p: Sellers on the European meals and feeds market offered South American soymeal pellets as much as $10 up following last night's sharply higher Chicago soymeal futures close and a stronger Project A night trade.
Most other products were offered unchanged to $2 up in sympathy with soymeal. No trades were reported during the initial stages of the market.

"The higher seller prices in soymeal met little buying interest this morning. There is no faith in the market and the rally in Chicago was seen as technical and dealers were not willing to buy that," one broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
